name: bearis-chat
description: Chat with your Bearis on-device LLM over the local network (OpenAI-compatible API).

bearis.apiBaseUrl.description: Bearis OpenAI-compatible base URL. Use your phone's Wi‑Fi IP and port 8080, ending with /v1 (e.g. http://192.168.0.2:8080/v1).

bearis.strictOpenAiAgent.description: When enabled (default), agent mode uses OpenAI-style tools only (create_new_file / write_file via tool_calls). No BEARIS_* blocks, no BEARIS_PATCH, and no Markdown-fence file inference. Turn off for legacy BEARIS_READ/LIST/SEARCH/GREP/WRITE/PATCH behavior.

bearis.agentMode.description: Continue-like default: off = chat only (HTTP body has messages, no write tools). Turn on when you want the extension to apply file changes. With strictOpenAiAgent (default), OpenAI tool_calls are used; when strict is off, BEARIS_* blocks apply.

bearis.writeToolsPolicy.description: Only applies when bearis.agentMode is true. "fileIntent": send create_new_file/write_file tools only when the user message looks like code/file work (or when the chat checkbox forces tools). "everyMessage": always attach write tools each agent turn (older behavior; less Continue-like).

bearis.autoApplyMarkdownFences.description: Fallback only: if the reply has no tool calls/BEARIS_WRITE, infer files from Markdown fences (e.g. ```html → index.html). Keep off for Continue-like tool-call behavior.

bearis.confirmWrites.description: Show a confirmation dialog listing files before creating or overwriting them on disk.

bearis.previewDiffBeforeApply.description: When confirming writes/patches, offer opening a VS Code diff tab per file (current vs proposed) before applying to disk. Disable to use only the Allow/Deny dialog.

bearis.maxDiffPreviewTabs.description: Recommended batch size: when there are more changed files than this, a multi-select quick pick opens so you choose which diffs to open (first N are pre-selected). You can select more; Apply still affects every validated file.

bearis.openDiffPreviewBeside.description: Open the first diff preview in the editor column beside the active one (keeps the chat/webview column easier to reach).

bearis.maxAgentSteps.description: Max model turns per user message (read-tool loops: each BEARIS_READ round + final reply counts as one).

bearis.maxReadFileChars.description: Max characters read per file for BEARIS_READ tool results (large files are truncated).

bearis.listMaxDepth.description: Max subdirectory depth when running BEARIS_LIST (0 = only the listed folder’s files).

bearis.listMaxEntries.description: Max file paths returned per BEARIS_LIST request (listing stops when reached).

bearis.codeIndexEnabled.description: Enable BEARIS_SEARCH and on-disk TF‑IDF index (classic relevance vectors; not neural embeddings).

bearis.codeIndexMaxFiles.description: Max files scanned when building the code index.

bearis.codeIndexMaxFileBytes.description: Skip files larger than this when indexing.

bearis.codeIndexChunkChars.description: Approximate characters per index chunk (line-based packing).

bearis.injectProjectRules.description: Append bearis.md and .bearisrules from the project root to the system prompt (Cursor-style project rules).

bearis.projectRulesMaxChars.description: Max characters of project rules to inject.

bearis.grepMaxFiles.description: Max files scanned per BEARIS_GREP request.

bearis.grepMaxMatches.description: Max matching lines returned per BEARIS_GREP block in the model reply.

bearis.grepMaxLineChars.description: Max characters of each matching line shown in grep output.

bearis.grepMaxPatternLength.description: Max length of a BEARIS_GREP pattern string.

bearis.includeActiveFile.description: Append the active editor file (truncated) to each user message so the model sees current code.

bearis.maxActiveFileChars.description: Max characters of the active file to send when includeActiveFile is on. Use 0 for a large default cap (~300k chars).
